commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Understanding can say hard things so that they come easily to the listener, and can see the fine meaning in the words of others, however hard that is. Say what you say clearly and without fault. What you hear may be faulty and unclear, but take what is useful in it.
